name: My High School Anime Love
source:
Immerse yourself in a romantic anime story where you play as a new student surrounded by four charismatic guys. Your choices will determine the fate of your first love!

[from [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.OrionStudio.Anime_School_Love_Story]Google Play[/url]]
